elements.element: Vendor must maintain commercial general liability insurance.
elements.evidence: Clause (k) requires Garman to maintain commercial general liability insurance throughout the Agreement term.

elements.element: Commercial general liability insurance must have a limit of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.
elements.evidence: Clause (k) specifies a limit of not less than USD 1,000,000 per occurrence.

elements.element: Commercial general liability insurance must have a limit of at least USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.
elements.evidence: Clause (k) specifies a limit of not less than USD 2,000,000 in the aggregate.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance.
elements.evidence: Clause (k) expressly requires professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance.

elements.element: Professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance must have a limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: Clause (k) specifies professional liability insurance of not less than USD 2,000,000.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, Vendor must maintain cyber/privacy insurance.
elements.evidence: Clause (k) requires cyber liability insurance where Garman processes Sparkling data, which supplies the required customer-data-processing trigger and cyber/privacy coverage obligation.

elements.element: When Vendor processes Customer Data, the cyber/privacy insurance must have a limit of at least USD 5,000,000.
elements.evidence: Clause (k) specifies cyber liability insurance of not less than USD 5,000,000 where Garman processes Sparkling data.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain workers' compensation insurance as required by law.
elements.evidence: Clause (k) expressly requires workers' compensation insurance as required by law.

elements.element: Vendor must provide certificates of insurance to Customer on request.
elements.evidence: Clause (k) requires Garman to provide certificates of insurance to Sparkling on request.

elements.element: Vendor must maintain professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance.
elements.evidence: Clause (k) expressly requires professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance.

elements.element: Professional liability (errors and omissions) insurance must have a limit of at least USD 1,000,000.
elements.evidence: The required limit is not less than USD 2,000,000, exceeding the fallback minimum of USD 1,000,000.

elements.element: If Vendor processes Customer Data, Vendor must maintain cyber/privacy insurance.
elements.evidence: Clause (k) requires cyber liability insurance where Garman processes Sparkling data, supplying the required conditional obligation.

elements.element: When Vendor processes Customer Data, the cyber/privacy insurance must have a limit of at least USD 2,000,000.
elements.evidence: The conditional cyber liability limit is not less than USD 5,000,000, exceeding the fallback minimum of USD 2,000,000.

result.reason: The added clause satisfies every preferred insurance requirement and therefore also exceeds the fallback limits. It leaves the existing integration clause unchanged and adds only directly related insurance mechanics, including term duration and expense allocation. Drafting is strong, although using “Sparkling data” rather than a defined “Customer Data” term could create minor interpretive ambiguity if the agreement defines data more precisely elsewhere.
